breakingChanges: Low-level YarnPreloadPlanner.Resources(tokens) callers must now pass the runtime command catalog; standalone preload planners require an attached catalog for command resource analysis.
Core lifecycle and service contracts now live in Majo.Runtime.Core.dll. Rebuild binary extensions against the updated addon; namespaces and source signatures remain unchanged.

Direction, timing and actor model types now live in Majo.Runtime.Domain.dll. Rebuild binary extensions. DirectionPlanner accepts IBackdropAppearanceResolver; ActorDefinitionResolver implements this read-only metadata contract.

Command definitions, binding, converters, registration, manifests and generic wait groups now live in Majo.Runtime.Commands.dll. Rebuild binary command extensions; namespaces, source signatures and command manifest format remain unchanged.

State persistence models/contracts, migrations, mutation gates, serialization and file storage now live in Majo.Runtime.Persistence.dll; resource contracts/cache/leases and look-ahead windows live in Majo.Runtime.Resources.dll. Rebuild binary extensions; namespaces, existing source signatures and saved state formats remain unchanged.
notes: Candidates rc.1 and rc.2 share runtime API and serialized state layouts.
Nested detour saves require the same compiled Yarn program fingerprint.
The installer does not migrate player saves; test historical saves before a game release.
